items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So Skippy said – and Ray. I love Ray – Skippy said

ctx.x: You were – I guess you were about . . .
So Skippy said – and Ray. I love Ray – Skippy said, “If you’re ever in New York, look us up.” That’s what I did. I looked him up. I had one piece that I sold all the bands, all of them.
